identity.title: The ALMaQUEST Survey: The Molecular Gas Main Sequence and the Origin of the Star-forming Main Sequence

paper_type_evidence.quote: In this work, we present results using 14 MS galaxies with $10 <$ log($\rm~M_{*}$/$\rm M_{\odot}$) $< 11.5$ taken from the ALMaQUEST survey.

targets.name: 14 star-forming main-sequence MaNGA galaxies from ALMaQUEST

evidence.quote: These galaxies are selected to have $10^{-10.5}$ yr$^{-1} <$ specific star formation rate (sSFR) $<10^{-9.5}$ yr$^{-1}$ without showing strong central starburst features.

question.value: Do spaxel-level Sigma_SFR, Sigma_H2 and Sigma_* form a 3D relation, and is the resolved star-forming main sequence a consequence of the SK and molecular gas main sequence relations?

evidence.quote: Our result suggests a scenario in which the resolved SFMS is the least physically fundamental and is the consequence of the combination of the SK and the MGMS relations.
